title: Regulated-practice warning indicators on every relevant page
description: Red warning badges with icon and text on dimension, group, question, cell and task pages whose decision maps to a regulated practice; data-driven from a mapping in the data contract.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Regulated-practice warnings
  Scenario: A mapped page shows a warning
    Given a dimension, group, question or task mapped to a regulated practice in the leaderboard data
    When the page is built
    Then it shows a red warning with an icon and the words 'Regulated decision' linking to its risk panel
  Scenario: The warning is not colour alone
    Given the page is viewed in grayscale or by a screen reader
    Then the warning is still identifiable by its icon, text and accessible name

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented in 8dfdccd: RegWarn component (triangle icon aria-hidden, words 'Regulated decision' plus the practice, accessible name 'Regulated decision: <practice>. Read the risk.', links #risk). Spec: 'every page of a regulated dimension shows a red warning that is not colour alone' and 'pages of an unregulated dimension carry no warning' (option order is mapped regulated: false).

right_now_summary: The team is adding accessible red warnings to mapped pages for regulated decisions.
